label: Activate instance triggers
description: Turn on one instance's per-instance triggers. A trigger reading the instance's infra copy needs that copy running first; triggers already on are left alone.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: The instance id your program gives it (`user-42`).

inputs.name: only
inputs.description: Only these triggers, named as the program writes them. Unwired: every per-instance trigger.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers are on.

then.message: ActivateInstanceTriggers '{id}' names {names} in `only`, which is no per-instance trigger of this program. Name each the way the program writes it (`inbox`, `work.inbox` inside a group, or `one.inbox` inside an included file).
